subject: Fee phasing & SOW split: proposed amendment for NimbleFin
messages:
From: Maya Sethi <maya@nimblefin.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblefin.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: amend order form to phase fees / split SOW

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looks great. Our finance team is asking whether we can phase the fees for the capacity top-up across Q1/Q2 invoices and split the SOW into an "Phase 1" (pilot 200k tokens/month) and "Phase 2" (full 1M tokens/month) to match our rollout. They also asked that the amendment call out invoice schedule and rollback rights during Phase 1.

Can you share a draft amendment (redline) and any notes on legal / billing impacts? Procurement is on copy — they need an internal timeline by next Friday.

Appreciate it,
Maya

--
Maya Sethi
Head of Platform Partnerships
NimbleFin

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Maya Sethi <maya@nimblefin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: amend order form to phase fees / split SOW

Maya — thanks, and totally reasonable ask.

Quick summary of what we'll propose:
- Amendment to add a two-phase SOW (Phase 1: 3-month pilot, reduced capacity and prorated fee; Phase 2: full capacity and standard monthly fee).
- Fee phasing: 50% invoice in Month 1 of pilot, 25% Month 2, 25% Month 3; Phase 2 billable once signed acceptance criteria are met.
- Rollback: if pilot acceptance criteria not met, option to terminate Phase 2 without penalties (we'll define acceptance tests).
- Billing: explicit invoice schedule and PO instructions; no change to base MSA indemnities but we will flag any SLA exceptions to legal.

I'm copying Laura for legal redline and Karthik for pricing ops. I'll attach a first-pass redline by EOD tomorrow. Is there a PO number we should reference?

Thanks,
Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0147

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: amend order form to phase fees / split SOW

Sean / Karthik — thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed an early draft and have the following legal items to consider before we send a redline to NimbleFin: 

1) Termination / rollback language — define explicit acceptance criteria and a clear remediation period (30 days) to avoid disputes.
2) Fees & refunds — if NimbleFin terminates after pilot because acceptance criteria fail, consider a partial credit for work completed; avoid full refund language.
3) Liability / SLA — keep standard MSA caps but carve out the invoice schedule as not affecting indemnities; if Phase 2 performance materially changes the risk profile, we can add a conditional SLA adjustment.
4) Audit & compliance — NimbleFin asked about SOC 2 evidence. Confirm we can share SOC 2 Type II report redacted (we can) and include an evidence delivery timeline in the amendment.

I attached markup v1 (nimblefin_amendment_redline_v1.pdf) with tracked issues plus a draft SOW split (nimblefin_sow_phase_split_draft.docx). Karthik — can you confirm the phased invoice math and whether we need to flow any credits through the PO?

If all good, I suggest we send the redline with a brief cover note and a DocuSign link for signature on the amendment (Phase 1 signature triggers pilot billing).

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: amend order form to phase fees / split SOW

Maya — attaching the redline and SOW split Laura prepared. See the key commercial notes below and next steps: 

Attachments: nimblefin_amendment_redline_v1.pdf (pdf, 142KB); nimblefin_sow_phase_split_draft.docx (docx, 28KB)

Key commercial points:
- Pilot fee phasing example: $48,000 total pilot fee -> invoice schedule = $24,000 (Month 1), $12,000 (Month 2), $12,000 (Month 3).
- Phase 2 transitions to monthly recurring fee per Order Form once acceptance criteria signed off.
- We propose acceptance criteria: successful completion of three production-run queries that meet latency & accuracy thresholds; we included measurable thresholds in the SOW.
- If acceptance criteria are not met, NimbleFin may elect to terminate Phase 2 and receive a credit equal to unearned Phase 2 fees for the first 90 days.

Next steps:
1) Please review the two attachments and confirm PO number and preferred signer.
2) If acceptable, we'll send via DocuSign (link included) with a 14-day signature window.
3) If Procurement needs a custom invoice schedule (monthly vs. net-30 batches), call out specifics and we'll update the amendment.
